points.description: Names dust particles / clay minerals (mineral dust) as ice nuclei.
points.partial_credit: Half if only a vague mention of 'particles' or 'soil' without dust or clay.

points.description: Names the other common nuclei: organic particles and ocean (sea) salts.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of organic material or salts is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks for covering roughly three quarters of the model answer: dust/clay, plus organic material and/or sea salt, in any wording. Give part marks for one or two correct items that are only partly covered. Give no marks for unrelated answers such as water vapour or rain alone. Extra wrong remarks do not cost marks.
